description: This file defines the XMLWriter class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, responsible for writing XML data to memory or disk, with temporary storage management and data retrieval functions.

classes.name: XMLWriter
classes.description: A class extending PHP's native XMLWriter to add temporary storage management, debugging, and data retrieval capabilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the XMLWriter with either memory or disk storage, managing temporary files accordingly.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Destructor that deletes temporary files if they exist.

methods.name: __wakeup
methods.description: Prevents unserialization of the object to avoid insecure state.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the XML data that has been written, from memory or from the temporary file.

methods.name: writeRawData
methods.description: Writes raw text data into the XML stream, encoding it appropriately.
